findingsAndRepairs.finding: React Query persistence filtering only matched exact kebab-case string segments.
findingsAndRepairs.repair: The denylist now recursively inspects string, array and object key parts after normalization and blocks dualSync, googleBusinessProfile, route-path and GBP variants.

findingsAndRepairs.finding: Safe telemetry accepted arbitrary strings under allowlisted keys, and exception distinct/group identifiers were not validated.
findingsAndRepairs.repair: Telemetry values and exception identifiers/groups now require bounded code/identifier syntax; content-like strings are dropped.

findingsAndRepairs.finding: Cron authentication and execution-lock failures returned before the inner retention handlers applied no-store headers.
findingsAndRepairs.repair: Both retention and health cron routes now wrap the final response, including authentication failures, with gbpNoStoreResponse.

remainingBlockers: The only server references to record_gbp_content_observation_v1 and inherit_gbp_content_lineage_v1 remain the typed adapter itself; producer owners must wire lineage registration.
Operator-attested backup/PITR and transformed-content policy evidence remain external and readiness must remain fail-closed.
Provider-owned GBP route privacy changes remain delegated outside this lane.
